OUR STORY

We started the Mount's very first surfshop in 1974 — Solar Surfshop —

Today, CJ, with decades of experience, the first person to run a Mount surf school. He's been fixing boards for over 20 years.

When you bring your board to Solar Surf, you're putting it in the hands of people who live and breathe the Mount surf culture.
